items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: The piano player, you ever know her? What her name? Her name, Camilla Todd.

ctx.x: Well, let's see, we got about 20 minutes of you and we got about 20 hours a day. How many guys? I'm trying to pick up some old musicians. Okay, well I'm going to ask you some questions. What happened to Camilla Todd? Is she still
around? The piano player, you ever know her? What her name? Her name, Camilla Todd.
I don't know her. Clarence Todd was her brother?
